topics.title: Avenciguat (sGC activator) – SSc Ph2 (1366-0031) OLE Cancellation and NDA Strategy

background.text: CN approval base case: Jul 2031. CDE feedback on Ph2 (1366-0031) IA plan received April 28: no further comments on IA plan. Corporate final decision April 22: OLE study (1366-0032) following Ph2 will not be conducted as company will put limited resources on prioritized projects. Global team discussing whether NDA submission leveraging single Ph2 data is possible.
background.quote:
Corporate final decision on 22 Apr: OLE study (1366-0032) following the ph2 study (1366-0031) will not be conducted in future as company will put limited resources on some prioritized projects.
Global team are recently discussing whether it is possible to submit NDA by leveraging single ph2 data.

todo.text: Local team to complete global core meeting package (EoP2) by end of May. Local team to work closely with global by providing local inputs and requirements from CDE.
